plugins.name: dsh-board
plugins.description: Persistent project kanban board: tickets stored as readable files in .dsh-board/, survive compaction and new sessions. Provides board_* MCP tools, a /board command family, an auto-refreshing local dashboard, and session-start/handover continuity.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 项目内持久看板：.dsh-board/ 文件账本 + board_* 工具 + /board 命令族 + 本地实时看板，跨会话与压缩不丢任务状态
